title: Bennett’s Conjecture in Lean 4: Counter-Models for the PSR-Reducibility of Spinoza’s Propositions V and XIV
reasoning: The paper formalizes Spinoza's Ethica (Pars I) in the Lean 4 theorem prover. It addresses a long-standing theological and metaphysical debate (Bennett vs. Della Rocca) regarding the Principle of Sufficient Reason and the definition of God, involving high-level components of theology, metaphysics, and hermeneutics.
